scope: A03 only; fixed 38980 English articles, no minimum words, no duplicate exclusions
unit: one article, equal within year; contrast equal mean of annual means, comparison minus baseline
M05: reuse sealed W_L/W_S; W_S=0 => no_prose NA; positive S and no L => 0; report difference in percentage points
M06: reuse sealed 1000*bold_intervals_S/W_S; W_S=0 => no_prose NA; projection failure => projection_error NA; no bold with positive S => 0

bootstrap.unit: all known single numeric author IDs sampled together across 2018-2025, all articles retained
bootstrap.p_values: not_run; no optional six-primary tests or Holm adjustment; secondary intervals not simultaneous

quantiles: linear, observed zeros retained, metric-specific NA excluded
list_DOM: count all ul/ol blocks and li nodes in saved clean DOM, including zero-word/non-prose items; allocate saved L words to nearest li exactly once (nested li and p inside li not double counted); mean item words includes zero-word li, no li => NA; list presence DOM and positive L-word presence separate
bold: saved T02 spans only, per prose unit; nested/adjacent bold handling unchanged; words counted once if overlapping one or more spans; no CSS inference
headings: all saved h1-h6; ASCII heading words via fixed tokenizer; H2/H3 density per S words; question is ASCII question-mark occurrence proxy, not grammatical classification; emoji is fixed T02 codepoint-range proxy, not visible grapheme count

position.order: saved S word tokens sorted by unit_index,unit_start; midpoint=(rank+0.5)/W_S
position.list: word membership, not li event count; item may span regions
position.bold_words: one count per S word overlapping saved bold spans
position.bold_events: each saved span anchored at first overlapping word; counted once even if span crosses a region
position.summary: article-equal region rates and separately labelled pooled word-weighted rates; empty region NA; W_S=0 retains all rows with NA; position summaries descriptive, no position CI

audit.selection: one available article per year and stratum by SHA256('42:A03:'+stratum+':'+article_id), duplicates across strata retained with role
audit.scope: not blinded; first two relevant flags/exclusions, first 6 list items and headings, first 6 saved bold spans with context; at most 700 chars of saved clean DOM; raw/clean markers retained; not population accuracy

A06_deferred: Conclusion/section-semantic attribution and template structure; no A06 work in A03
heading_number_rule_note: Case-insensitive; leading year-like numbers included; no semantic section classification
